verdict.rationale: Aliases and masked addresses are a fair question for an email service, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents Gmail aliases, plus-addressing, or masked/relay addresses. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: Workspace custom-domain email, and filters that forward mail to another address.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use aliases or masked addresses so sign-ups and strangers never learn my real address
